metadata.description: Plugins for building product UI with the Zebra Design System

plugins.name: zebra-design-system
plugins.description: Build UI with the Zebra Design System: Figma-to-code and brief-to-UI skills, the component usage catalog, the design voice, the UX patterns, and setup/lookup commands. Pairs with the @zebra-design-system npm packages.

plugins.name: zebra-patterns
plugins.description: The Zebra UX patterns for any product, whatever it is built with: component-agnostic rules for screens, navigation, controls, states, devices, accessibility, copy, theming, AI and data, with skills to apply them and to audit a product against them. Needs no Zebra package.
